summary: hermes-agent commits per-PR A/B evals under evals/ with runnable harnesses and scorecards that report token savings next to measured accuracy: lean+recovery compaction recall 68.3% vs 45.8% for the current policy at 3.3x fewer tokens (49K vs 162K; 96.7% uncompacted), core-tool deferral −7% to −23% tokens with grand accuracy 0.916 vs 0.923, and browser_exec −60% to −66% tokens with 18/18 runs succeeding on both arms. The scorecards also record results that went against the change, such as gpt-5.6-terra accuracy falling from 0.938 to 0.879 and the clarify tool being used in 7/18 runs instead of 18/18 under core-tool deferral. The runs need live paid models, the compaction transcripts are not committed, and per-run rows for the deferral, read-tool and browser suites are gitignored, so those results are summary tables; the session_search eval commits all 108 per-run rows (52/54 vs 49/54 passed). The toolperf figures (−21% turns, −29% tool calls on qwen3-coder-30b) are stated in a README next to the harness, without committed results.
